versions.content: Handling if an assembly process is interrupted If the SOME/IP TP module interrupts the assembly process because of a detected error, the SOME/IP TP module shall consider the following points: • call PduR_SomeIpTpRxIndication() with result set to E_NOT_OK for the PDU ID that refers to the used SomeIpTpRxNSdu of the affected SomeIpTpRxChannel . • Set the corresponding SomeIpTpRxNSdu to state NSDU_AVAILABLE , after PduR_SomeIpTpRxIndication() returns. • The Rx timeout time defined by SomeIpTpRxTimeoutTime shall be canceled (if still running) for this assembly process that corresponds to the PDU ID and its identified transmission source (see [SWS_SomeIpTp_00096]).
